title: No-Bake Blueberry Cheesecake
excerpt: Make a delicious no-bake blueberry cheesecake with a soft texture, a crunchy base and all the natural sweetness of our favorite fruit.
imageAlt: Slice of no-bake blueberry cheesecake on a white plate, topped with whole fresh blueberries.

ingredients.text: 200 grams plain or whole-wheat biscuits (María-style cookies)
400 grams cream cheese at room temperature

steps: Crush the cookies until they are a fine powder and mix them with the melted butter.
Press this mixture into the bottom of a 20-centimeter springform pan and refrigerate it while you prepare the filling.
Hydrate the unflavored gelatin in the four tablespoons of water and, after one minute, dissolve it in the microwave for 15 seconds without letting it boil.
Beat the cream cheese with the powdered sugar until smooth and creamy.
Add the cold heavy cream and keep beating until it gains some body.
Pour in the dissolved gelatin in a thin stream while beating gently to fully incorporate it.
Add half of the whole high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca and stir with a spatula using folding motions.
Pour the mixture over the cookie base, smooth the surface and decorate with the rest of the fruit on top. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before unmolding.
tips: To better preserve the natural bloom and firmness of the fruit you don’t use for decoration, keep it in the fridge unwashed until you are ready to eat it.
You can run the outside of the pan under warm water for a few seconds so the cheesecake unmolds more easily.
Take the dessert out of the fridge ten minutes before serving to enjoy a much creamier texture.
